Thanks for the loop, Michael. Alexis — quick checklist from Contracts to help us triage and hit your Aug 18 expectation: 

1) Template selection guidance (if not provided, we default to Standard Commercial MSA):
   - Standard Commercial MSA (fastest first-pass)
   - Enterprise MSA (for committed capacity/pricing guarantees)
   - Data Residency Addendum (if you require region-limited data storage or processing)

2) Required party facts (please confirm in the attached Signatory_Roster.xlsx):
   - Full legal entity name for contracting (exact capitalization / punctuation)
   - Billing entity and billing address (tax IDs if applicable)
   - Authorized signatory name, title, and level of authority (e.g., VP Finance can sign up to $X)
   - Primary technical contact for deployment/data residency conversation

3) Governing law & jurisdiction preference (CA, DE, UK, etc.)
4) Any non-standard terms you anticipate (IP carveouts, export-control limits, or unique indemnities)

Redline turnaround: for Standard MSA + Order Form we usually provide a first-pass redline within 3 business days after the party facts and signatory roster are confirmed. If you confirm Enterprise MSA or need residency addendum, please allow up to 7 business days for a substantive first-pass.

Ive attached a short questionnaire (MG-MSA-questionnaire.docx) that speeds up our mapping — if Alexis can populate the Signatory_Roster.xlsx and return by EOD Aug 12, well aim for an Aug 17 first-pass; otherwise Aug 20.
